_: Department line drawings from the owner's uploads (CERVICAL FASCIA.pdf, GREAT VESSELS OF THE NECK.pdf), mapped to LEARN note sections. Captions are ours. Colour atlas plates copied from published atlases are left out. prepare.py crops them into ./out (never committed); encrypt.mjs writes the encrypted copies to source/public/dept/ and the manifest to source/public/dept-figs-v16.js.

Muscles deep to the sternomastoid
